NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026 Event Highlights: AI in Action Across Europe
result.description:
Relive NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026, where developers, researchers, startups, partners, and industry leaders came together to explore the ideas and technology shaping AI across Europe and around the world.

From NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang’s keynote at Tempodrom and packed sessions at STATION-Berlin to hands-on training, partner demos, the Build-a-Claw activation, the Festival of Lights, and four Microducks in the spotlight, see the moments that brought GTC Berlin to life.

Watch the keynote and explore sessions on demand: https://nvda.ws/4e95G6L

result.title: NVIDIA Halos SAFE: Autonomous Vehicle Safety Evaluation From Road Testing to Simulation
result.description:
See how NVIDIA Halos SAFE AV connects real-world testing, simulation, and vehicle hardware to evaluate autonomous vehicle safety in one continuous loop.

Discover how NVIDIA Omniverse NuRec reconstructs real driving scenarios and NVIDIA Cosmos generates variations across traffic, weather, and edge cases.

🔗 Explore NVIDIA Halos → https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/ai-trust-center/halos/autonomous-vehicles/
